commit message:
fix(base): Do not copy FairModule::vList

The copy ctor tried to copy vList.

But this is a thread local variable.  So either it already
exists, then nothing happens in the current code.
Otherwise a new (empty) one is created and then copied into
itself.

Not to mention it copies an owning raw pointer into another
owning raw pointer.
author: Christian Tacke <58549698+ChristianTackeGSI@users.noreply.github.com>
